name: REPLACED_AT_SEED_TIME
description: Harness-seeded switch-auto-create V2 template for the LIVE-start regression. One minimal standalone Gen2 VM whose only NIC names a virtual switch the harness deliberately does NOT provision (a run-tagged ghost name, guaranteed absent from the host). No domain/topology/capability roles and no credential slots, so the missing switch is the sole variable: the deploy must create it. Unlike the planning-only variant this template is actually deployed so the runtime creates the switch, which is then asserted to be Internal. Safe to delete.
